items.q: Two charges of 37 microC and 27 microC are 28 m apart. Find the force between them. Use k = 9 x 10^9, correct to four decimal places.
items.s: F = k q1 q2 / r squared = 9e9 x 37e-6 x 27e-6 / 28 squared = 0.0115 N.
items.t: Electricity and magnetism: a unified view

items.q: A coil of 697 turns experiences a change of flux of 0.721 Wb in 2.82 s. Find the induced emf, correct to three decimal places.
items.s: emf = N (change in flux)/(time) = 697 x 0.721 / 2.82 = 178.205 V.
